notes.title: Update v1.04
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I receive more and more feedback with new (horny) players joining and trying to address every little issues/improvements. So here is a little patch with some additions:

- On videos, the "next" button now appears 1s after the beginning of the video to avoid clicking on it by mistake.
- The "locked" tooltip doesn't appear anymore if you unlocked the fast mode.
- The "Download" button in the gallery for pictures wasn't working properly for some people, I added a double solution and it's now giving way better results. As notice, all downloaded pictures are saved in your "My Pictures" folder (in My Documents).
- I noticed the "New step - Reach a new step with Zoey." achievement percentage was a little bit lower. Added a security to be sure you unlock it when reaching this point of the adventure.
- Added a little system to avoid the "missing translation" at the end of each chapter to appear in the dialogue bar.
- Improved translation for French (thanks to the community).

Thank you again for your feedback and very nice reviews!
I also take the opportunity of this message to announce that a bundle is coming with all the Zoey's game!

notes.title: Update v1.03 - Fast mode + auto mode + new language Portuguese
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's Ben from NSFW18 Games! We received feedback about little features to integrate to make your life easier in the game. We added them and fixed some elements that seems confusing in the game (black screen in Gallery).

[h1]Update v1.03[/h1]
- Settings button in Visual Novel: We added a little panel in the VN part that includes three little features (bottom right corner, next to the continue button).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023413/9dec741b7a5057df5b09e10b9e360237cbb81cc5.png[/img]
-[b] FX button[/b]: remove the FX on the continue button.
- [b]>>> button[/b]: unlocked after finishing the story once, it allows you to go faster in the story and skip all the dialogues. One click = instant skip to next dialogue.
- [b]auto button[/b]: when activated story will continue itself without having to click on Continue button (every 3 seconds). It doesn't skip choices or animations.

- [b]We added an Achievement checker[/b], if you reach the end of the story, it will automatically check if you collected all achievements (except those 2 connected to the Gallery) and grant you with those you are missing so we are 100% you have them all.

- [b]We removed some pictures from the gallery that seems "bugged"[/b]. There were screens from the story where the OC was closing his eyes (aka black screens). We also removed some duplicates to avoid confusion.

[h1]Languages[/h1]
- Portuguese Brazilian language added to the game by a member of the community.
- English reworked. A member of the community reviewed the English and improved it.
- Chinese is in the process of being proofread, it should be available soon.
- Want to participate in translation / proofreading, join us on Discord.

[h1][url=https://x.com/Nsfw18G]More than 3000 players joined Zoey's flatsharing[/url], very big thank you for you support![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023413/b410e914d82ff52c48965bf7816b6437d8c25b46.png[/img]
